=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:253-267 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS` repeats an unbounded `*` over overlapping alternatives (`-[Cc]\s+\S+` vs `-[A-Za-z]`; `--(?:git-dir|work-tree|namespace)\s+\S+` vs `--[A-Za-z][\w-]*(?:=\S+)?`), and `git_remote_op` (lines 259-263) embeds it twice; input like `git -c -c -c ... -c status` therefore backtracks about Fibonacci(N) times in `pattern.search` inside `_check_sandbox_instructions` (lines 887-893).
  WHY: The verdict `instructions` are model-produced and open to prompt injection, and `MAX_TEXT = 1200` (lines 193, 809) still allows about 390-395 `-c` tokens; `validate --sandbox-check` runs through `unblock_py` with no timeout, outside the model timeout, so the judge hangs with no verdict, no `invalid_verdict` marker and no log line; this is on by default via `UNBLOCK_INSTRUCTION_SANDBOX_CHECK_ENABLED=true`, and the new tests (lines 3729-3738) do not cover this backtracking path; severity disagreement: gemini BLOCKER, sonnet/minimax/luna/qwen MAJOR, sonnet's separate PERFORMANCE note on the same root cause NIT.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:253-261 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The value-taking branches of `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS` match option arguments with `\S+`, so a quoted argument that contains a space (for example `git -C "/repo root" fetch origin main`) is not skipped and `git_remote_op` does not match.
  WHY: The sandbox check accepts the verdict without a re-ask, then the fetch fails in the network-less implementer sandbox and the round is used up (the fun-token-multi-chain#639 failure mode); this only affects quoted arguments with spaces.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:260-261 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `git_remote_op` regex matches natural-language prose such as "no git remote", including text from the judge prompt itself.
  WHY: Legitimate verdict instructions that mention "git remote", even to forbid it, are refused or pushed into an invalid-verdict state.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:265 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `gh_cli` pattern `\bgh\s+(api|pr|issue|run|repo|release|workflow|label|auth|secret|search|status|gist|codespace)\b` matches these subcommands in any context.
  WHY: It can give false positives when the words appear in a description of the environment rather than in a command instruction.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1563-1598 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the re-asked verdict also fails validation, the log records only `reason=other` and the wait marker carries only `reason=invalid_verdict`; the captured `validate_err` text is dropped.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell from the logs why the re-ask failed (disallowed verdict, missing `instructions`, `jq` parse failure, a still-present git command), so postmortems fall back to re-running the judge.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:line 253, `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS = r"(?:\s+(?:-[Cc]\s+\S+|--(?:git-dir|work-tree|namespace)\s+\S+|--[A-Za-z][\w-]*(?:=\S+)?|-[A-Za-z]))*"`. It appears twice in the `git_remote_op` pattern (lines 260-261), and `_check_sandbox_instructions` (line 887) runs it with `pattern.search`. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ambiguous, unbounded repetition (`-c` matches both `-[A-Za-z]` and `-[Cc]\s+\S+`; `--git-dir` matches both long-option branches) splits N tokens in about Fibonacci(N) ways and backtracks through all of them when no remote op follows.
  WHY: Prompt-injected verdict text such as `git -c -c -c … -c status` (about 395 tokens fit under MAX_TEXT = 1200, line 193) hangs `validate --sandbox-check` (`unblock_py`, lines 122-125, has no timeout) outside `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_SECS`; no verdict, wait marker or log line is written, and the item is re-dispatched; on by default. The reviewer reasoned this from the regex and did not run it.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:line 253, the `-[Cc]\s+\S+` and `--(?:git-dir|work-tree|namespace)\s+\S+` branches of `_GIT_GLOBAL_OPTS`. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A quoted option argument containing a space (`git -C "/repo root" fetch origin main`) is not skipped, so `git_remote_op` does not match.
  WHY: The verdict passes validation and the fetch then fails in the network-less sandbox, using up the round (the fun-token-multi-chain#639 failure mode).
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:lines 253 and 260-261 (the same root cause as the SECURITY finding above). | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Ordinary instructions that chain several `-c key=value` or `--git-dir`-style options before a local subcommand also backtrack, with cost growing exponentially.
  WHY: The cost roughly doubles every couple of tokens and the validate step has no timeout; the reviewer says to fix this together with the SECURITY item.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: Postmortems cannot pinpoint the cause from logs alone and fall back to re-running the judge.
